part.text:
Migration complete. Build succeeds with routes `/` and `/about` prerendered as static content.

Changes made:
- `app/layout.tsx` — root layout with `<html lang="en">`/`<body>` and shared `metadata` (favicon) + `viewport` exports
- `app/page.tsx` — Home page with per-page `metadata` export, replaced `next/head` and `<a>` with App Router metadata API and `next/link`
- `app/about/page.tsx` — About page, same conversion
- `pages/` directory and `_app.tsx`/`_document.tsx` removed (no longer needed in App Router)
